delay.$description: Core animation delays — wait before a transition starts

easing.$description: Core cubic-bezier curves — how an animation accelerates over time

100.$description: Ease-in — starts slow, then speeds up (feels like an exit or departure)

200.$description: Ease-out — starts fast, then slows down (feels like an arrival or settle)

300.$description: Ease-in-out — slow at both ends, faster in the middle (smooth standard UI motion)
